_doc: Train track (M10). Track can NEVER be damaged (PLAN §0.3): no ignite, no melt, no blastTo, hard 255. Any later fire, blast, melt or flow rule must leave a cell alone when its ground or its material has hard 255 (js/sim/cells.js already does for cooling crust and burnt-out ground). rail = the track bed (a ground); rail_bridge = track over shallow water (a cell standing in the water); platform = the stone edge of a station.
